map.基于 PDCA 循环的物业服务品质管理评估，评估标准制定、检查执行、问题整改各阶: PDCA-cycle-based assessment of property service quality management, evaluating maturity across standard setting, inspection execution and problem rectification
map.📖 查看「品质（标准/检查/改进）循环 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Quality (Standard / Inspection / Improvement) Cycle" guide
map.PDCA 评估：P 标准制定、D 检查执行、C 检查评估、A 改进提升四阶段各题: PDCA assessment: the four stages P standard setting, D inspection execution, C inspection evaluation and A improvement are scored 1 to 5 per question; stage score = mean of that stage's questions; total score = mean of the four stages; grade follows the average: 4.5 and above continuous optimisation, 3.5 to 4.4 effective operation, 2.5 to 3.4 partially implemented, 1.5 to 2.4 initially established, below 1.5 not established.
map.PDCA 循环：Plan(标准制定) → Do(检查执行) → Check(检查: PDCA cycle: Plan (standard setting) → Do (inspection execution) → Check (inspection evaluation) → Act (improvement)
map.成熟度 1-5 分，综合得分反映品质管理闭环水平: Maturity scored 1-5; the composite score reflects the closure level of quality management
map.建议每季度评估一次，持续推动品质改进: Assess once a quarter to keep pushing quality improvement
map.📚 深度解析：品质（标准/检查/改进）循环: 📚 Deep dive: quality (standard / inspection / improvement) cycle
map.物业品质部按保洁、安保、绿化、维修标准做日周月检: The property quality department runs daily, weekly and monthly inspections against cleaning, security, greening and maintenance standards
map.检查问题录入整改并复查闭环: Inspection issues are logged, rectified and re-checked to closure
map.月度品质评分用于项目经理考核: Monthly quality scores are used to assess the project manager
map.本周检 40 项，达标 34、问题 6（保洁 3、安保 2、绿化 1）→ 6 项: 40 items checked this week, 34 compliant, 6 problems (cleaning 3, security 2, greening 1) → 6 items rectified within 3 days; 5 passed re-check and 1 was deferred, carried into the next period.
map.各维度权重：保洁 30、安保 25、绿化 20、维修 25，得分 88、90、8: Weights per dimension: cleaning 30, security 25, greening 20, maintenance 25, with scores 88, 90, 82, 85 → weighted 86.4; greening below 85 goes on the improvement list.
map.品质检查多久一次？: How often should quality inspection happen?
map.日检（现场）+ 周检（专项）+ 月检（综合），关键区域加密。: Daily (on site) plus weekly (themed) plus monthly (comprehensive), with more frequent checks in key areas.
map.检查发现问题不整改算通过吗？: Does finding a problem without rectifying it count as a pass?
map.不算，必须整改后复查通过才算闭环，否则持续挂账。: No. Closure requires rectification followed by a passing re-check; otherwise the item stays open on the books.
